candidate_skills.canonical_definition: Determine a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when denominators differ.

candidate_skills.canonical_definition: Rewrite a whole number or nonstandard mixed number into a compatible whole-and-fraction form needed for subtraction without changing its value.

candidate_skills.canonical_definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator and/or subtract whole-number and fractional parts once the quantities are in compatible form.
